personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, high-density operations console that feels fast, structured, and inherently native, empowering admins with clear actionable data.

spacing.rule: Generous comfortable padding for cards, but tighter vertical density inside list rows for easy scanning.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use glass on bottom-sheet handles and headers.
Use glass on floating quick-action buttons.
dont's: Never apply glass to form fields, standard dashboard cards, or dense list rows.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication gate for platform administrators.

states.error: Inline text below input or a top banner for invalid credentials.

screens.layout: Clean, distraction-free screen. Hero image/abstract graphic at the top fading into the surface. Standard single-column form with labels above inputs. Primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: High-level command center displaying core KPIs, real-time alerts, and financial summaries.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards and charts.
states.empty: Illustration indicating zero data available yet.
states.error: Card showing 'Failed to load metrics' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: 4 KPI cards (2-column grid). Middle: Fraud/Quality Alerts (SOS, COD) rendered as distinct, elevated alert cards. Bottom: Charts (Line chart for revenue, Donut for categories). Sticky quick actions FAB at bottom right.

screens.name: Live Bookings
screens.purpose: Real-time dispatch and monitoring interface for all platform bookings.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing search bar and horizontal scrollable filter chips (All, Pending, Assigned, En-route, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled). List view below with compact cards showing Booking ID, status badge, time, and primary action. Tapping a card opens a detailed Bottom Sheet for reassignment (showing partner list with stats).

screens.name: Cities & Geofencing
screens.purpose: Manage operational regions, surge pricing rules, and service availability.

states.error: Error banner at the top of the list.

screens.layout: List of active cities. Each row shows city name, active zones count, and status toggle. Clicking a row opens a full-screen sheet or modal to edit pincodes, surge multipliers, and view raw JSON configs.

screens.name: Partners & KYC
screens.purpose: Review partner applications, manage documents, and monitor active fleet.

states.error: Retry block for partner fetch failure.

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Pending KYC, Active Partners, SOS Alerts). For KYC: List of expandable partner cards showing document thumbnails (Aadhaar, PAN, DL, Police) and Approve/Reject buttons. For Active Partners: List showing online status dots, COD limit warnings, and payout request toggles.

screens.name: Finance
screens.purpose: Manage commissions, generate weekly settlements, and view GST invoices.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No financial data for selected period'.

screens.layout: Top section: Global commission sliders (15-20%) with save action. Middle: Settlements generation block. Bottom: List of recent customer and partner invoices with download/view icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the provided color palette: #1E3A8A (Blue) as primary and #F59E0B (Amber) as secondary. Do not introduce generic indigo or random Material palettes.

The app requires Devanagari-friendly typography since it toggles between English and Hindi. Use 'Mukta' for display and 'Hind' for standard text. Limit font weights to 400 and 500 maximum. Do not use 600+ weights.
Implement an iOS-Native Clean layout: comfortable padding around cards, clear structural dividers, and a glassmorphism bottom tab bar.
For the Dashboard, group the 4 KPI cards in a 2-column grid with `space-between` and flex wrapping, maintaining consistent padding on both sides.

When displaying Fraud/Quality alerts on the dashboard, use the semantic error (#EF4444) and warning (#EAB308) background tokens lightly tinted for the card surface, ensuring clear distinction from standard KPIs.
On the Live Bookings screen, wrap the horizontal filter chips in a sticky, frosted-glass header block so they remain accessible when scrolling through large booking lists.
Ensure the KYC queue cards support expandable/collapsible views for the 4 documents (Aadhaar, PAN, DL, Police), keeping the base card compact to enable fast queue processing.
Always apply a minimum 44x44pt hitSlop on all interactive elements (chips, toggles, icon buttons) to prevent touch misses on mobile.

Images fetching: For placeholder avatars or background elements, leverage the provided abstract/office imagery. Ensure image loading states use the designated blur hash or `surfaceTertiary` skeleton block.
Do not use emojis in the UI. Rely on the specified Ionicons set for all graphical indicators (e.g., alert triangles, user avatars, document icons).
